description.narrative: This activity ENCISS: Civil Society Strengthening Phase III.This Project contributes to domestic accountability is a component of Enhancing the Interaction and Interface Between Civil Society and the State to Improve Poor People's Lives (ENCISS) reported by FCDO with a funding type of 104 - Procurement of Services and a budget of £6,665,770. It works in the following sector(s): Democratic participation and civil society, Decentralisation and support to subnational government, Elections, Media and free flow of information, Human rights.
